description: Form-associated chat input with auto-growing textarea; submits its form, or fires chat-input:send when standalone

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Form field name; required for the value to appear in FormData (no default)

attributes.name: maxlength
attributes.description: Character limit; over it the element is invalid (tooLong) and sending is blocked

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Disables the textarea and send button (an ancestor fieldset[disabled] does the same)

events.name: chat-input:send
events.description: Enter or send button when not inside a form; message is trimmed and the input clears afterwards

events.name: chat-input:change
events.description: The value property was set to a new value

properties.name: value
properties.description: Current textarea content (get/set; setting fires chat-input:change)

methods.name: reportValidity()
methods.description: Check validity and show the browser message on the textarea

childAttributes.name: data-send
childAttributes.description: Marks the send button; submits the form or fires chat-input:send

structure.description: The message field; give it an accessible name (aria-label="Message" is added when it has none)
